title: Per-person platform-admin identities — the shared seeded admin cannot carry attribution or approval
description:
## BLUF

Platform-admin is a **shared** seeded account today, so no rule that depends on *which person* acted can be made real — including the two-approver shape for bulk re-key ([KS-582](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-582)) and any honest attribution on a recovery action.

Carried over from @peter's own candidate list on KS-480, unchanged.

## Detail

Every guardrail on the `register-connector` path is currently "platform-admin or refuse" (`services/api-gateway/src/routes/platform.ts:499-509`). That is a capability check, not an identity check. Consequences:

* An approval rule ("two approvers for a batch") cannot be enforced — the same shared credential can satisfy both sides.
* Recovery-action audit records the role, not the person.
* Off-boarding a person does not remove their platform-admin access, because the access is not theirs.

**Gates:** [KS-582](https://linear.app/secuura/issue/KS-582) (approval shape) cannot be implemented until this lands.

**Done when:** platform-admin actions attribute to a named person, and the shared seeded account is no longer a route to platform-admin in any environment that matters.

Findings checked against* `develop` `c8ce65dca`*; Finding B confirmed live on the demo VM read-only.*
